item.title: EU Commissioner Has Bad News for PS5 Users
item.description:
An EU commissioner has suggested that there is not much the European Union can do legally to stop PlayStation from abandoning physical discs. Sony is planning to stop releasing the media format for its PlayStation consoles, with the change taking effect in January 2028.

Many gamers are trying to stop the Japanese company from discontinuing discs. There is currently a Change.org petition about PlayStation canceling the release of physical discs, and so far it has collected hundreds of thousands of signatures. Some people are also turning to legislators and lawmakers to push for new acts and regulations that could prevent Sony's decision to kill PlayStation discs. However, a recent comment from a politician has sparked another wave of disappointment among gamers.

PlayStation Will Continue Supporting Physical Games After 2028

Sony's controversial decision to stop physical PlayStation game production after January 2028 comes with a notable asterisk allowing some leeway.

16
By Dominik Bošnjak

There Is Not Much That the EU Can Do, Says Commissioner

As reported by the Irish Mirror, Michael McGrath, EU Commissioner for consumer protection, recently commented on Sony's new policies, saying, "Companies are free to offer games and services in the manner that they see fit." McGrath also explained that "it does come down to commercial and contractual freedoms." His comments come after the European Commission previously dealt a blow to the Stop Killing Games movement.

In June 2026, the European Commission announced that it would not proceed with the Stop Killing Games' request to propose regulations that could prevent publishers from sunsetting games. Now, the same scenario seems to be unfolding with Sony's no-disc policy. The EU is unlikely to try to block the Japanese company from moving forward with its controversial decision. It appears that European copyright and intellectual property laws prevent legislators from introducing regulations that directly force publishers to present, sell, or support their products in a specific manner.

In the case of the Stop Killing Games movement, the EU has promised to look into creating a code of conduct to better manage a game's end-of-life process. So, PlayStation fans can hope that a similar step is taken to improve digital game ownership rights. However, judging by McGrath's comments, it is unlikely that the European Union will introduce any firm laws against Sony's plans to discontinue discs.

Of course, McGrath isn't the first to share such disappointing news with gamers. Earlier in July, games industry analyst Dr. Serkan Toto echoed a similarly grim outlook for the future of PlayStation. Toto said that Sony is unlikely to change course on its choice to end physical game discs, despite the ongoing backlash. He suggested that the customer base is so large that even if thousands of people stopped purchasing games or canceled their PS Plus subscriptions, Sony would survive the impact and move forward with the decision.

Gamers don't seem to have given up on fighting for physical discs, though. On social media, they are using #BoycottSony and the phrase "No disc, no buy" to encourage fellow PlayStation users to resist the decision. The gaming industry has also reacted to PlayStation ending physical media with mostly negative sentiment, and several well-known developers have criticized the company's policies. However, it remains to be seen how effective these user-led movements will be, as the legal side of things currently does not appear to be in favor of consumers.

item.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced: What To Do After Completing The Main Story
item.description:
The main story of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced follows Edward Kenway 's journey from an ambitious pirate to the captain of the Jackdaw , taking players through 12 Sequences packed with naval battles, exploration, and memorable characters.

Once the credits roll, though, you might be wondering what's actually left to do. Thankfully, the Resynced version adds a huge amount of new content on top of everything that already existed in the original game. Here's everything you can jump into after completing the main story.

How to Swim to the Lowest Point on the Map in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced

If you want to get the Davy Jones' Locker trophy/achievement in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, here's where to swim to the lowest point.

By Chris Jecks

What to Do After Completing the Main Story in AC Black Flag Resynced

A World Without Gold

The biggest piece of post-story content is the brand new A World Without Gold chapter, which introduces Maynard as its main antagonist.

Unlocked after completing Sequence 11 , this optional chapter features eight new missions and eventually rewards you with a new weapon for the Jackdaw. While you don't need to complete it to finish the main story, it expands on the aftermath of Blackbeard's encounter with Maynard and is easily one of the best additions for both returning and new players.

Officer Quests

AC Black Flag Resynced introduces three new Naval Officers that Edward can recruit for his crew. Although two of their questlines become available shortly after Sequence 4 , you can comfortably leave them until after finishing the story.

Completing every Officer Quest not only gives you more background on each character, but also unlocks powerful Jackdaw abilities and is required if you want to progress further through A World Without Gold .

Side Quests

Now that the main story is behind you, it's the perfect time to tackle the game's many side quests. Most of these are brand new additions, including Blackbeard's Treasure , Captain Stede Bonnet's questline, Art Lover , Damn Fine Gear , and the hunt for the Mayan Steles scattered across the Caribbean. Each one offers unique rewards while giving you another reason to explore the world.

Hunts & Contracts

Just like the original game, there's no shortage of activities if you enjoy combat. You can complete Assassination Contracts , Naval Contracts , and Templar Hunts , all of which reward you with large amounts of money, useful resources, and even legendary outfits. They're also a great way to earn enough Reales to purchase the more expensive ship upgrades.

Exploration

The Caribbean is packed with islands waiting to be explored. You can search for hidden treasures, collect crafting materials, capture forts, and uncover secrets. There are also underwater diving locations where you'll search for treasure while avoiding sharks lurking below the surface.

Naval Combat

Sailing the Jackdaw and taking on enemy ships remains one of the biggest highlights of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced . As you continue upgrading your ship, you can capture enemy vessels to expand your Fleet and send them out on missions for additional rewards.

Once you're looking for a real challenge, however, it's time to hunt down the six Legendary Ships . These are easily the toughest naval encounters in the game, but overcoming them is well worth the effort thanks to the rewards and satisfaction that come with sinking them.

With several fresh rewards now available, it's a great time to redeem every active code before any of them expire. Be sure to check back later for new codes and future updates to the list.

How to Redeem Codes for Bloons TD 6

Before you can get the rewards, you will need to redeem the codes, which is not really difficult. But if you've just installed the game, you'll need to complete the tutorial to access the redemption option. Here are the instructions on how to redeem the codes in case you don't how to do it in this tower defense game:

  • Launch Bloons TD 6 .
  • Go to the main menu of the game.
  • Here, pay attention to the upper left corner of the screen. Below your avatar, you will find a button with a gear icon. Click on it.
  • In the new menu, pay attention to the upper left corner. Here, next to the blue arrow button, you will see a green button with a gift icon and the inscription Redeem Code. Click on it.
  • This will open the redemption menu. There will be an input field and two buttons below it, Close and Redeem. Now, enter manually, or better yet, copy and paste one of the above-mentioned active codes into the input field.
  • Lastly, click on the green Redeem button to submit your reward request.

If everything is done correctly, a notification will appear on the screen with a list of rewards received.

How to Get More Bloons TD 6 Codes

Just like with Roblox codes, you can find more codes on the game's official social media, and luckily, Bloons TD 6 has plenty of them. By carefully monitoring each of them, it is highly likely that you will find fresh codes.

  • Official Bloons TD 6 Discord server.
  • Official Bloons TD 6 Facebook page.
  • Official Bloons TD 6 YouTube channel.

Bloons TD 6 is available on PC, Xbox, PlayStation, and mobile devices.
